description: This Java source file defines the DesktopWindowService class, which provides operations for managing desktop windows, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting windows within desktop sessions. It interacts with repository classes and handles resource not found exceptions.

classes.name: DesktopWindowService
classes.description: Service class providing window management operations within desktop sessions.

methods.name: listWindowsForSession
methods.description: Lists all windows associated with a specific session ID.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a new desktop window within a specified session using provided request data.

methods.name: updateWindow
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing window within a session, ensuring it belongs to the session.

methods.name: deleteWindow
methods.description: Deletes a window from a session after verifying its association.

methods.name: ensureSessionExists
methods.description: Private helper to verify if a session exists by its ID, throws exception if not.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a DesktopWindow entity to a DesktopWindowDto for data transfer.
